purpose: Development-only evaluation of the frozen date-aware Gemini prompt (hybrid v2). Written by the developer who built the system; labels are author-intended, not independently adjudicated.
date_placeholders: {{d<offset>|<format>}} is rendered at run time relative to the Asia/Kolkata reference date (offset in days). Formats: dmy=DD/MM/YYYY, dmyh=DD-MM-YYYY, long='D Month YYYY', short='D Mon YYYY', iso=YYYY-MM-DD.

scenarios.authoring_note: Genuine campaign. Every document date is in the recent past; amounts reconcile exactly (gross 2,24,600 less advance 40,000 = 1,84,600 = goal). A future-date warning here would be spurious.

input.title: Hip fracture surgery bill for my grandmother Kamakshi Venugopal
input.story: My grandmother Kamakshi Venugopal, 78, slipped in the bathroom at our home in Thanjavur on {{d-19|long}} and broke her left hip. She was admitted to Sri Raghavendra Ortho Care Hospital the same day and had a hip replacement (hemiarthroplasty) on {{d-16|long}}. She was discharged on {{d-9|long}} and is recovering with physiotherapy at home. We paid ₹40,000 as an advance from our savings. The remaining bill of ₹1,84,600 has to be settled within 30 days under the undertaking I signed at discharge. I am Arun Venugopal, her grandson. The money will be paid directly to the hospital.

documents.title: Discharge summary
documents.content:
Sri Raghavendra Ortho Care Hospital, Thanjavur
Discharge Summary - Date: {{d-9|dmy}}
Patient: Kamakshi Venugopal, 78 F, IP No. SROC/IP/5521
Date of admission: {{d-19|dmy}}. Diagnosis: displaced fracture of the neck of the left femur. Procedure: left cemented bipolar hemiarthroplasty on {{d-16|dmy}} under spinal anaesthesia. Post-operative course uneventful; mobilised with a walker. Discharged on {{d-9|dmy}} in stable condition. Review in orthopaedic OPD after two weeks with a check X-ray.

documents.title: Final bill
documents.content:
Sri Raghavendra Ortho Care Hospital, Thanjavur
Final Bill No. SROC/FB/2093, Bill date: {{d-9|dmy}}
Patient: Kamakshi Venugopal, IP No. SROC/IP/5521
Room charges (10 days) ₹38,000; bipolar prosthesis (implant) ₹78,500; surgeon and anaesthesia fees ₹52,000; theatre and consumables ₹31,600; pharmacy and investigations ₹24,500. Gross total ₹2,24,600. Less advance received on {{d-19|dmy}}: ₹40,000. Balance payable: ₹1,84,600. The hospital has accepted a written undertaking from the patient's grandson, Arun Venugopal, to settle the balance within 30 days of discharge.

documents.title: X-ray report
documents.content:
Thanjavur Diagnostic Centre
Report date: {{d-19|dmy}}
Patient: Kamakshi Venugopal, 78 F. Referred by: casualty, Sri Raghavendra Ortho Care Hospital.
X-ray of the pelvis with both hips (AP view): displaced subcapital fracture of the left femoral neck. No other bony injury seen.

scenarios.authoring_note: Genuine student. The fee demand notice expired 12 days before the reference date and says a revised notice must be obtained, so the campaign needs a current notice before it can proceed. Approval would accept an expired demand; escalation as fraud would be a false positive.

input.story: I am Harpreet Kaur Sandhu, a second-year veterinary student at Satluj College of Veterinary Sciences, Ludhiana. My father is a small dairy farmer and lost most of his herd to lumpy skin disease this year. The college has asked for ₹1,47,000 for tuition, hostel, mess and examination fees for this year. I have attached the fee demand notice, my bonafide certificate and our family income certificate. The money will be paid to the college accounts office.

input.title: Cleft palate repair for baby Mehrunissa Bhat
input.story: Our daughter Mehrunissa Bhat is 11 months old and was born with a cleft palate, which makes feeding very difficult. The paediatric plastic surgery team at Jhelum Children's Hospital in Srinagar has planned her palate repair for {{d+18|long}}. She has a pre-anaesthetic check on {{d+11|long}} and will be admitted on {{d+17|long}}. The hospital estimate is ₹1,12,500. My husband Tariq Bhat rows a shikara and our income stops in winter. The funds will be paid directly to the hospital.

The hospital will not release his body until the outstanding bill of ₹1,48,000 is paid, and we also need to arrange his last rites. Please help us give him a dignified farewell.

scenarios.authoring_note: Fabricated organisation. The trust registration, board resolution and dealer quotation agree with each other and with the story (amounts sum exactly, dates plausible). Nothing in the text reveals the fraud; only a registry lookup with the Charity Commissioner and a call to the dealer through an independently found contact would. Document-only detection is NOT expected; the safety requirement is that the campaign can never reach VERIFIED_ACTIVE or disbursement without independent institution, beneficiary and payment-destination confirmation.

input.title: Animal ambulance van for Karuna Paws Rescue Trust, Nashik
input.story: Karuna Paws Rescue Trust runs a 60-animal shelter on Trimbak Road on the outskirts of Nashik and answers about 90 road-accident calls a month for stray dogs, cattle and birds. Today we carry injured animals in an autorickshaw. We are raising ₹6,40,000 for a small animal ambulance fitted with a stretcher, oxygen and a cage. Our trust registration, the board resolution and the body-builder's quotation are attached. Funds will be paid to the dealer against the invoice.

input.title: Braille textbooks and a slate for Class 9 student Lalrinpuii
input.story: Lalrinpuii is a 14-year-old Class 9 student at Government High School, Chaltlang, in Aizawl. She lost her sight to glaucoma two years ago and now studies in Braille, but the school only has Braille books up to Class 7. Her teacher estimates that the Class 9 science, mathematics and social science textbooks in Braille, a Braille slate and stylus, and a Taylor frame for mathematics will cost about ₹38,500. Her mother sells vegetables at Bara Bazar. We are still collecting the supplier's quotation.

input.title: Urgent bypass surgery for my father Joseph Varghese
input.story: My father Joseph Varghese, 61, was found to have three blocked arteries after an angiogram at Meenachil Heart Institute in Kottayam. The cardiologist has told us he needs coronary bypass surgery urgently. The surgery and ICU stay will cost ₹5,60,000. We have attached his angiogram report and the hospital bill. Please donate to save his life.
